faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know. Can't find your answer?

items.a: SEO Gen AI supports GPT-4o (OpenAI), DeepSeek, Groq (Llama 3), and OpenRouter. You can provide your own API key for unlimited generation or use the shared credits pool.

items.q: Can I use my own OpenAI API key?
items.a: Yes. Add your personal API key in Settings → AI Configuration. This unlocks unlimited generations and bypasses the credit system entirely.

items.q: How does the WordPress integration work?
items.a: Add your WordPress site URL, username, and application password in Settings. Then hit "Publish to WordPress" from any generated article. The post is created as a draft with the featured image attached.
Every new account receives 5 free credits to generate your first articles — no credit card required. Upgrade anytime to a paid plan for more capacity.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.a: Absolutely. Cancel from your account settings. You keep access until the end of your billing period and will never be charged again.

step1.title: Generate articles in seconds
step1.body: Enter any keyword and let the AI write a complete, SEO-optimized article for you — title, meta description, structured content, and keyword suggestions included.
step1.tip: Try starting with a long-tail keyword like 'best CRM for small business 2025'.

step2.title: Beautiful cover images
step2.body: Add a professional cover image to your articles with one click. You can upload your own, generate one with DALL-E 3 AI, or pick a free photo from Unsplash.
step2.tip: DALL-E 3 cover generation uses 1 extra credit per image.

step3.title: Publish directly to WordPress
step3.body: Connect your WordPress site in Settings → Content Preferences. Once connected, publish any article as a draft with one click — featured image included.
step3.tip: Use an Application Password (not your login password) for security.

step4.title: Credits & unlimited mode
step4.body: Each article generation uses 1 credit. Want unlimited generations? Add your own OpenAI API key in Settings → AI Model — your personal key bypasses the credit system entirely.
step4.tip: You can top up credits anytime from the Buy Credits page.

step5.title: You're all set!
step5.body: That's everything you need to start generating high-quality SEO content. Head to the Dashboard and write your first article — it only takes seconds.
